notes: dna_partner_of is catalogued symmetric and functional (one partner per base in DNA), so Func(dna_partner_of) is a catalogue axiom, not a presupposition. The stored 'guanine pairs with cytosine' gives way (gives_up): with one partner, guanine's partner is now adenine. Letters T and G are surfaces of thymine and guanine (no catalogued abbreviation relation). GC content is the class GcBase. 'Replaced by uracil in RNA' is encoded as the DNA partner not being part of RNA (thymine is not in RNA, a stored background fact; guanine is). Stale bridge and revision facts of the earlier related far question were removed on 2026-11-14 (the related questions are now related[0] and related[1]).

bridge_refs.gc_content: GC content is the share of a DNA molecule's bases that are guanine or cytosine.
